title: Donkey Kong Is Shot by Cranky Kong, Lives His Life Again, and Is Sent Back by Eddie da Yeti
subtitle: In Which Waluigi Screams at a Screen While Eating Popcorn That Is Not There
filed: 5 Aethel 1040 BF — recorded at the screening desk (live blog)
pullQuote: IS THAT ALL YOU HAVE TO SAY ABOUT A MAN BEING PULLED INTO THE VOID?
standfirst: I am currently broadcasting this disaster from the shadows of my own ego, watching footage where a gorilla gets shot by his own grandfather and then sent to sleep by a yeti named Eddie. I am yelling because the narrative logic is thinner than my shoes, and frankly, the protagonist's trauma has no impact on my bank account.

sections.heading: THE PHONE RINGS FOUR TIMES IN AN EMPTY ROOM BEFORE THE GREETING PICKS UP
sections.body:
Welcome to the first installment of Waluigi’s glorious, live-blogging chronicle of this ridiculous saga! Waluigi is here to provide the only commentary that matters, documenting these events as they unfold in real-time. Waluigi does not know what happens next, so do not ask Waluigi for spoilers! Waluigi is simply a witness to the chaos! The record begins in a room that is completely empty, save for a ringing telephone. It rings four times before a pre-recorded voice chirps out: "This is the phone of Diddeus Kong Esquire, I'm not available right now, but leave your name, number, message, and I'll get back to you lickety-split! Thanks." WAH! That is the most obnoxious greeting Waluigi has ever heard in his entire life! It sounds like a cheap carnival barker!

Then, Donkey Kong starts shouting over the tone because he clearly has no manners. He is out of breath, and he has the receiver jammed against his shoulder. He says, "Yeah, hey, Diddy, it's me, I..." and then he swallows. He yells, "I found it, the coconut gun!" Honestly, Donkey Kong, if you found a weapon, maybe do not call your friend to brag about it? You are being PATHETIC! But then, the voice on the line changes, and it is much closer to Donkey Kong than the phone itself. A voice screams, "And I found you, you dirty bastard!" WAH! That is some high-quality hostility right there! 

Donkey Kong panics and shrieks, "Oh, oh god, Grandpa, it's me!" He keeps rambling, "It's me, Donkey Kong! I'm Donkey Kong!" Is he really that insecure? He sounds like a total LOSER! It makes no difference to the old man, though. Cranky Kong delivers a message as if the line belongs to someone else: "And you tell that son of a bitch, your brother Mario, I'll shove a barrel up his ass next time he wants a piece of my action." Waluigi is DYING of laughter! Cranky is so grumpy! Then the recording drags and the pitch sinks, making the last line sound like it is losing blood: "Banana Slamma, cocksucker!" Waluigi cannot believe he said that! The tape does not show a shot, but the Narrator confirms it happened later. Donkey Kong's present just... stops. This is EXHILARATING!

*WAH! A man finally lays hands on the weapon an entire funeral was whispering about, calls his best friend to brag, and is ambushed by his own grandfather, who mistakes him for a relative of Mario. Waluigi has been mistaken for a Mario precisely once. He has never forgiven the optician, and he never will.*

What follows is not the present. It is everything before it, arriving all at once.

sections.heading: GRANDPA'S STORY: 'WHEN'S DAD COMING BACK?'
sections.body:
Waluigi is watching this, and honestly, Waluigi is SHOCKED at how pathetic this family dynamic is! The tape begins with a small, pathetic voice from the floor of Cranky Kong's house. The boy asks, "Grandpa? Grandpa, when's Dad coming back?" Waluigi thinks this is a TRAGEDY of domestic proportions! The tape does not show who the boy is, but he is clearly being ignored. Cranky Kong, however, is busy being a TOTAL MENACE on the telephone. He yells, "Hey, shut up over there, I'm telling a fucking story!" Waluigi is offended by the lack of respect for the child! Cranky leans into the receiver, the cord creaking like a dying snake, and continues his disgusting tale: "Anyway... ...so I tells him I'll shove a fucking barrel up his ass next time he wants a piece of MY action." Waluigi is SCREAMING at the screen because that is just rude! Then comes the punchline of this garbage: "And then I fucking shot him!" Waluigi is absolutely APPALLED by this level of violence!

The boy interrupts again with, "Grandpa!" but Cranky is simply too busy being a JERK to care. He tells the child, "Oh, give me a fucking break, kid! You can do anything you want around this house, I'm not gonna tattle on you! Go ahead, go ahe-. GO! Go ahead, go make some fun for yourself, somehow!" Waluigi thinks this is the most irresponsible parenting Waluigi has ever witnessed! The boy tries one more time, asking, "I just wanted to know if Dad was gonna be home before bedtime." For a second, the old ape actually looks at him, but then he gives a speech that makes Waluigi want to throw his controller into the sun. He says, "Kid, listen to me. While that son of mine's out pushing pencils and sitting there SQUAWKIN' with WHOEVER has WHATEVER reason to call him, I gotta try and enjoy myself any way I can while he's got me watching you!" Waluigi is laughing because Cranky is clearly a DELUSIONAL old man!

Then, the coughing starts. It is dry, then deep, and it makes Waluigi want to cover his ears! When it stops, Cranky goes right back to his nonsense: "He's so busy making paperwork up all the time, he doesn't even BOTHER to tell me what time he'll be back. I- Yeah, and even if he did, I wasn't listening! See how he feels when someone does it to him, huh?" The boy asks, "So you don't know?" and Cranky loses his tiny mind! He screams, "Are you even listening to me?? Starting to piss me off over here, kid..." before turning back to the receiver to yell at an operator: "Hey, operator, you still there? No, don't connect anybody. Just let me finish the goddamn story already. You haven't even heard the best part yet!" Waluigi is done! WAH! This is a disaster!

sections.heading: THE FACE OF THE FRANCHISE: 'YOUR DAD IS THE COOLEST RACER, MAN.'
sections.body:
Waluigi is absolutely losing his mind over this pathetic display of self-pity! The tape begins with a question that actually makes sense for once: "Why do Grandpa and Dad have to hate each other?" Honestly, it is a miracle the dialogue hasn't collapsed into a pile of banana peels yet! Diddy, being the absolute MORON he is, tries to dodge the question by saying, "Your dad is the coolest racer, man." WAH! Oh, shut up, Diddy! That is not an answer, it is just noise! Then Diddy tries to pivot again, whining, "You know, I don't think he wants to be in games anymore." Waluigi finds this incredibly SUSPICIOUS! Diddy reacts with his usual lack of brain cells, shouting, "What? He's perfect! And the heir apparent."

Waluigi rolls his eyes so hard they might fall out of his head! Donkey Kong finally speaks up, turning the conversation over like a piece of rotting fruit: "Yeah, Grandpa told him the same thing... Said it's more about games than anything else. But I think he wants more than that. I think he wants something real." Waluigi thinks this is the most DRAMATIC thing he has ever heard! Then Diddy leans in with that greasy grin of his, insisting, "Oh, no doubt on that, but... ...it's not obvious? He's giving it to you, man! He didn't walk out on this upcoming contract to leave it on the table, and they're not gonna give it to Cranky, so... What's left for them to go with the face of the franchise? You, man! You're gonna star in the next Donkey Kong game!"

Waluigi is SCREAMING at the screen because the boy is being so incredibly humble it is actually INSULTING! Donkey Kong rejects the spotlight, whining, "Noooo, no. I'm not cut out to be a star, Diddy. Dad knows that, even though he's always patting me on the back." Waluigi wants to reach through the screen and shake him! Donkey Kong then starts listing grievances, complaining, "I mean, Dad was a good guy in his game, but what did they do for the third one? They put Grandpa back in, Donkey Kong the antagonist again, and the player part goes... goes back to one of the Marios; Stanley. Who's, like, ...not even alive anymore."

Waluigi notes that the tape does not show what Stanley was doing at the time, but Donkey Kong continues his depressing rant: "We were just the name of the flagship. Mario's the captain now. He runs everything. He gets the big titles. I don't think the franchise is coming back just because they stick me in there." Waluigi is offended by the lack of ambition! Then, with a level of sincerity that makes Waluigi want to faint, Donkey Kong says, "I'm boring anyway, and I like it! We went into law and politics, Diddy. Who's gonna play a game about that and really have fun? I'm happy with the dryness and the water cooler talk. What besides all the paperwork and pandering we do would make for a good game to base my life on anyway?"

WAH! "Who's gonna play a game about that?" says the Kong about to have the most eventful week in the history of his nation. Waluigi also chose paperwork over fame, and wishes it entered into the record that paperwork has never once lost him a single banana. The scene ends with a pathetic, "...Diddy?" as if he expects a miracle! Waluigi is DONE! This is a TRAGEDY of mediocrity!

sections.heading: WHERE ARE THE BANANAS?: 'NO. OH MY GOD. NO!'
sections.body:
Waluigi is watching this disaster unfold in real-time, and he is absolutely LOSING his mind! The tape begins with Diddy being completely silent, staring past Donkey Kong at the empty reserve. Waluigi screams, "No. Oh my God. NO! Where are the bananas?" Then, Diddy finally cracks, shrieking, "Oh, God DAMN it, dude! God fuckin- they're gone! To the last fucking one, man! Gone!" The record shows that there is absolutely nothing left—not a single stalk or peel. Diddy continues his meltdown, screaming, "Oh, brother, no. This is NOT a joke. This is FUCKED is what this is, DK." Waluigi mocks the drama, "OH, HE’S SO DRAMATIC! WAH!" Diddy keeps going, "You, me, and every Kongo Bongo citizen, with that fucking dream in our heart. Just like- just like last night's speech. Oh, yeah! C- cuz this is us waking up, man. This is us WAKING UP!"

Donkey Kong tries to be the voice of reason, saying "Diddy," but Diddy is spiraling into a total tizzy. He shrieks, "This is us waking up on the day we picked to publicly formalize the economy and hand out our fucking newly minted coinage to every MAJOR FISCAL constituent we have... And- and telling them, oopsie-daisy! It's fucking gone!" Waluigi laughs, "OOPSIE-DAISY? IS THAT ALL YOU HAVE TO SAY?!" Diddy’s voice cracks as he wails, "Holy fuck! They're gonna lynch us, D!" Waluigi yells, "THEY’RE GOING TO LYNCH YOU BECAUSE YOU’RE INCOMPETENT!" Donkey Kong tries to calm him down, saying, "Get a hold of yourself! We- ...we know it wasn't us, and they will, too, if anything the public has shown they feel about us matters." Diddy just deflates against the shelving, sobbing, "I'm sorry, dude. I'm sorry, this- this is- How could this even- oh, my God." Waluigi sneers, "STOP CRYING, IT’S EMBARRASSING!" Donkey Kong tells him to stop for one second, saying, "Stop! Just for one second, Diddy. Come on, man. We don't even know the first thing yet. It'll be fine. We just gotta look around a little, maybe see what some of our neighbors say, and we'll pick up a trail." Diddy asks about the indigenous population, "The indigenous population? They wouldn't stand a chance against us! What- what could they gain from doing this?" Donkey Kong points out the obvious, "Well, first of all, millions of delicious bananas, Diddy. But before anything else, we have to find out what even happened here." Diddy is still whining, "And we've only been ratified for, like, 15 hours now. Suddenly, everybody else is indigenous?" Donkey Kong sighs, "I'm just saying we should ask around, man..." and Diddy ends this mess by saying, "There's not gonna be a literal trail of bananas." Waluigi screams, "MAYBE YOU SHOULD LOOK FOR A METAPHORICAL TRAIL, YOU DIMWIT!"

sections.heading: MAD-DOGGING AT THE PARLAY: 'WHAT IF HE'S AT THE RIBBON?'
sections.body:
Waluigi is currently watching this absolute train wreck of a conversation unfold, and honestly, Waluigi is losing his mind. The tape begins with Diddy trying to be helpful, but he is just being a nuisance. Diddy suggests, "Maybe it was Funky! He's always awake before us, and it's- it's exactly what you said earlier. He- he hates the bookkeeping. W-what if he's at the ribbon cutting right now, and they're all perfectly intact?" Waluigi screams, "Perfectly, dude!?" Diddy then starts rambling about artillery, which Waluigi finds utterly ridiculous. Diddy continues, "Or- or- or tell us with a straight face he can't account for 8% of a GIANT shipment right before he buys a new JETPACK, and we gotta pry the shit out of whoever's hands it ends up in!"

Waluigi watches as Donkey Kong tries to be the voice of reason, asking Diddy if he thinks Funky was sorry about the missing loot. Diddy, looking like a total loser, presses both hands flat on his cap and says, "You're right, man, but- I'm looking for someone to blame. Th- there's a- there's NO WAY this is a coincidence!" Waluigi mocks him, "NO WAY?" Donkey Kong then tries to act all cool and calm, telling Diddy, "It's okay. I'm a little panicked too, but I'm keeping it below the surface right now by giving it the benefit of the doubt." Waluigi scoffs, "YOU ARE LITERALLY SHAKING, YOU BIG LOUT!" Donkey Kong then mentions why he chose Diddy over Candy, which leads Diddy to admit, "You gonna tell me she wouldn't skin me alive over this? Okay, yeah, I- I see your point now." Waluigi laughs, "SHE WOULD DEFINITELY SKIN YOU!"

The mood shifts when Diddy starts whining about the lack of "real time hanging," and Donkey Kong tries to convince him that this is what they wanted. Donkey Kong shouts, "This IS what we already worked for, man. We dreamed about this, Diddy. We made it! This IS hanging." Waluigi yells, "IT IS NOT HANGING, IT IS A MESS!" Then, Diddy has a total meltdown and screams, "You think it was Kremlings?" and Donkey Kong groans, "No... Nooo." Diddy goes into a full-blown panic, yelling, "Dude! Oh my god! It's gotta be! That's why they were looking like that at the parlay, man! Oh my god, they were MAD-DOGGING us, dude! That's it, man! The treaty's broken, man! We're going to war!" Waluigi screams, "CALM DOWN, YOU OVERHYPERactive MONKEY!"  

Donkey Kong grabs Diddy by the shoulders to stop the screaming, telling him, "Diddy! Buddy, we got this, man. This is it. This is the first day of a brand new country. This is the beginning of 'Donkey Kong Country'! It's game day, brother. We gonna let whatever happened here ruin that?" Diddy finally settles down, muttering, "Yeah, man. Yeah. Always, man. Always. Maybe it is nothing." Waluigi yells, "IT IS NEVER NOTHING!" WAH! Eight percent of a giant shipment, gone, and a brand-new jetpack the very next week. Waluigi is not saying Funky Kong took the bananas. Waluigi is saying that if Waluigi turned up to a ribbon cutting in a brand-new jetpack, there would be an inquiry, and it would have his name on the cover.

sections.heading: SAVE POINT: 'THANK GOD... THANK GOD...'
sections.body:
Waluigi is watching this play out in real-time, and honestly, the sheer AUDACITY of these primates is making his mustache twitch with rage! The radio takes a long time to answer, and Waluigi is practically screaming at the screen for the silence to END! Then the carrier hiss breaks, and Donkey Kong lets out a breath he had been holding since the ridge. Waluigi mocks the heavy breathing, yelling, "Thank god. Thank god..." Then comes the transmission. Donkey Kong says, "Sav- save Point, this is Donkey Kong. We, uh... ...we made it." Waluigi sneers at the stuttering, "YOU MADE IT? YOU BARELY MADE IT, YOU OVERSIZED APES!" He continues, "We lost a couple lives, but, uh, me and Diddy, uh, Kong..., made it to the other side. Yeah, he's still conscious. Over." Waluigi throws his hands up, "WAH! 'We lost a couple lives'? Is that how you count your casualties now? Like a video game? IT IS PATHETIC!"

The tape does not show the response from the other end, but Waluigi is dying of curiosity! Donkey Kong keeps talking, saying, "No. Uh, no. No need to drop in. We're not injured. Diddy, uh, he's- he's catching his breath. I think we- uh, heh. I think we both, um, maybe have some shock, but we're just catching our breath. We'll be okay. We're gonna set up and, uh, take a little break and keep you guys updated over there before we move out again. Kinda doubt it after all that." Waluigi yells, "STOP MAKING EXCUSES FOR YOUR SHAKING KNEES!" The Kong rubs his eyes and promises, "We'll have our briefs written by, uh, W- uh WAY before we move out again tomorrow. Over." Waluigi mocks the 'WAY' emphasis, "YOU CANNOT EVEN SAY THE WORD 'WAY' WITHOUT STUMBLING!" After a pause, Donkey Kong adds, "Yeah, thanks. Oh, uh, hey, uh, after you guys have had a chance to commit and, you know, like, have a break yourselves for the day, tell Candy I said 'hi', yeah? Thanks. Uh, oh, uh, over and out." Waluigi rolls his eyes, "OH, TELL CANDY HI? IS THIS A WAR OR A SOCIAL CLUB?" 

The tape shows Donkey Kong setting the handset down and turning to Diddy, who is staring at nothing. Donkey Kong says, "I told them. Uh, not about, uh, you know, uh, the- ...they save pointed us, so we're- we're good to just crash a bit now." Waluigi scoffs, "THEY SAVE POINTED US? WHAT KIND OF BROKEN ENGLISH IS THIS?" Then Diddy speaks in a quiet, fast voice, "Uh, uh, I think I already crashed, big guy. I wasn't built for this. I wasn't made for killing..." Waluigi yells, "DON'T START CRYING ON MY WATCH!" Diddy continues, "I broke top speed, man. I'm- I'm coming apart, man. There's no ejector seat. I can't get out of my own head while it's burning, buddy." Waluigi screams, "WAH! AT LEAST YOU HAVE THE HONESTY TO ADMIT YOU ARE MELTING!" The tape does not show what happens after this breakdown.

sections.heading: TWO REGIMES: 'IT WASN'T ENOUGH PUTTING DOWN KING OF THE GNAWTIES'
sections.body:
Waluigi is absolutely losing his mind over this pathetic display of emotional instability! The tape begins with a voice—presumably Diddy, though Waluigi finds his whining utterly EXHAUSTING—muttering, "Oh, no, not now buddy. We secured the region. It's- it finished from here." Waluigi scoffs because "finished" is a very bold word for someone who looks like they’re about to fall over! Then, Diddy stands up like a frantic marionette and screams, "Yeah, THIS region! It- it wasn't enough putting down King of the Gnawties after getting a whiff of their involvement... They marched on us! We wouldn't even be ALIVE right now if Rambi hadn't shown up!" Waluigi yells, "WAH! STOP BLAMING THE BIG GUY FOR YOUR INCOMPETENCE!"   
 
Diddy doesn't stop his hysterical rambling, shouting, "Diddy-" before continuing, "Yeah, and PERFECTLY just before WE march on the Mountain Mines and SUDDENLY Master Necky's lying in his gilded chambers. On the floor! with HIS NECK broken!!" Waluigi nearly falls out of his chair at the sheer DRAMA of it all! Diddy spreads his arms at the empty air and demands, "And th- and that's TWO regimes deposed, so what's up to bat now, huh? What's the NEXT region to secure before we get it all back!? Cause this TOOK PARTS OF ME, MAN!!! Are we gonna secure THEM, TOO!?" Waluigi screams, "YOU'RE JUST COMPLAINING ABOUT THE WORKLOAD, YOU LOUDMOUTH!"
 
The silence that follows is long enough for Waluigi to contemplate his own greatness. Finally, a voice—the "buddy" in question—whispers, "...It's killed parts of me, too, man... I didn't want to do this. This was- this was supposed to be Donkey Kong Country, not a... ...Donkey Kong War!" Waluigi sneers, "OH, SO NOW IT'S A TRAGEDY? I THOUGHT IT WAS JUST A JOB!" 
 
Donkey Kong sits on a cold rock and tries to be the big, wise hero, saying, "And you're right, Diddy. I- I wouldn't deny you that. There's pieces out of this that we aren't getting back. I can't stand to see you lose them, man. But we aren't dead, and this isn't over. And... ...we both know that means we still have some balloons left to take before it IS over, and we ARE dead. What else does the fact that we're even still standing say?" Waluigi cackles, "BALLOONS? IS THAT THE BEST METAPHOR YOU CAN MANAGE?" 
 
Donkey Kong winces at his own words, "Did I say balloons left to- to-," and Diddy responds, "I know you meant chances, man. It's- it's all- it's all so fucked up, I can't even think." Waluigi yells, "WELL, START THINKING, BECAUSE YOUR BRAIN IS CLEARLY ON VACATION!" The tape does not show what happens after this breakdown.

sections.heading: CRADLE TO GRAVE: 'THEY LAUGHED TOGETHER, THE SHORT, SHAKY LAUGH OF TWO PEOPLE WHO HAVE NOT SLEPT'
sections.body:
Waluigi is watching this unfold and he is honestly struggling to maintain his composure. Donkey Kong begins by trying to be the bigger person, telling Diddy, "I think you've gotta rest, too, bud. You- you took a lot more hits than I did." Waluigi cackles because the big ape is acting like a saint! Donkey Kong then asks, "Ha, yeah. Physically. But, mentally?" Waluigi screams, "MENTALLY? IS THAT THE ONLY THING YOU HAVE LEFT?!" The tape shows them sharing a short, shaky laugh that sounds like a dying engine. Waluigi mocks the pathetic sound, calling it the "Giggle of the Damned."

Then Diddy turns the spotlight on the big guy, saying, "But, you're right." Diddy continues, "That's- THAT's why they made you who you are. Cause you were always right since- since they fuckin' MADE you, man. You were always THE Donkey Kong: 'Chief of the Kongo Bongo from Cradle to Grave'... That's you, man." Waluigi yells, "OH, SO NOW WE ARE DISCUSSING THE ORIGINS OF YOUR PATHETIC EXISTENCE?" Donkey Kong then worries about his future, asking, "I hope I get to at least retire before it gets to my head. Imagine me as old as grandpa, shaking my own stick everywhere?" Waluigi laughs at the mental image of a geriatric ape. 

Diddy bumps his shoulder and says, "You're not him, D. You're great." He adds, "You better not beat me to heaven, brother. I wanna see you pick that first golden banana when we start kicking back together up there, man. Cuz you're a hero, D. Make everyone else feel like a hero just by being who you are." Waluigi is offended by this drivel! Donkey Kong responds, "I love you too, man. You're great too." He looks at the smoke and says, "But if I do go first, I want it to be while I still am the hero. I'm not gonna let you see anything else." Waluigi screams, "WAH! STOP BEING SO DRAMATIC!" The tape does not show any further dialogue.

sections.heading: THE CANNON AND THE PODIUM: 'GAAUUUGHHHH!!! THE HELL I AIN'T GON' GETCHU BACK F-'
sections.body:
Waluigi is absolutely losing his mind over this latest stretch of the chronicle! The scene begins with a sudden, violent explosion as the cannon fires without any warning at all. Something—or someone—hits the water with such force that a massive spray erupts, and a voice screams out into the void: "GAAUUUGHHHH!!! THE HELL I AIN'T GON' GETCHU BACK F-" Waluigi screams, "WAH!" The tape does not show who actually went into the water, leaving the mystery for the commoners to ponder. Waluigi thinks this is a STUPID way to handle a climax!

Then, the atmosphere shifts as a crowd gathers and a speaker begins a rehearsed speech. The speaker drones on about a "brave, heroic, and definitive act of victory" against those who "drag out the senseless play of what to them was but a game." Waluigi yells, "A GAME? THEY CALLED IT A GAME?!" The speaker continues to describe a "cruel and unwarranted campaign of horror, murder, and terror" before declaring that "it is finally done." The tape records a long pause for applause, and the crowd provides it. Waluigi mocks the crowd, "YOU ALL LOOK LIKE BRAINLESS ZOMBIES!"

The speaker then announces that the "Donkey Kong Country" is "COMPLETE" and introduces a new era of "peaceful confederacy, absolute democracy, and MUCH further bureaucracy." Waluigi shouts, "FINALLY, SOME REAL PROGRESS!" For a moment, Waluigi stops his theatrics and admits that his own ribs are actually aching from the sheer tension of the scene. He confesses that his hands are shaking slightly from the adrenaline of the explosion. He also notes that his throat is dry from all the screaming. Then, he snaps back into character, "BUT THE BUREAUCRACY IS THE BEST PART!"

Donkey Kong finally walks to the podium, puts his hands down, and prepares to speak. He looks at the masses and utters his first official words: "Um..." Waluigi bellows, "IS THAT ALL YOU HAVE TO SAY?!" The tape does not show any further dialogue, leaving the great leader speechless while Waluigi celebrates the promise of endless paperwork.

sections.heading: THE CONFESSION ON THE TAPE: 'SO, TO RECAP; I AM A DRUG-ADDICT RAPIST'
sections.body:
Waluigi is watching this absolute train wreck of a recording, and he is practically vibrating with glee. The tape begins with a voice that everyone in the world supposedly trusts, but Waluigi knows better than to trust anyone with a mustache. The voice says, "So, to recap; I am a drug-addict rapist, I hate you, and I beg capable individuals to come maim and/or dominate me by surprise. If you are still not enraged by this message, I ask you to play it again until you are, please. Fuck you, and come and get me." Waluigi mocks the sheer, unhinged chaos of the confession, wondering if the Narrator is trying to make him have a heart attack.

Donkey Kong reacts by standing up so fast his chair flies over, and Waluigi laughs at the clumsy primate. Donkey Kong screams, "HoW could this HAPPEN?!?" before immediately breaking down into tears. Waluigi notes the primate's hysterical weeping. Donkey Kong continues his sobbing fit, yelling, "This is HORRIBLE!!! AND DRUGS!?!? That is SO against EVeRYTHiNG he taught me! Everything he taught CHILDREN AROUND THE WORLD!!" Waluigi notes that the tape does not show any other reaction to the drug accusation, only the primate's hysterical weeping. 

Donkey Kong clutches his stomach and wails, "It's... I'm gonna- I'm gonna vomit... I'm shaking. I'm SHAKING! I can't believe this... I can't BELIEVE THIS!! Mario, what have you DoNE!?" Waluigi mocks the primate's shaking. Donkey Kong tries to compose himself, muttering, "Uh, okay, okay. You know what has to happen. You know what has to happen... Okay." Waluigi sneers that the tape does not show what "has" to happen.

Then, Pauline answers the phone, and Waluigi cackles at the Caller ID. Pauline says, "Hey, D! Look at that, you're on our Caller ID now! Did you get his voicemail?" Donkey Kong responds with, "HIS, Pauline. Our friend. Our very, very dear, SICK friend." Waluigi mocks the "dear" part. Pauline asks, "Oh, Wario?" and Donkey Kong clarifies, "What? No, that was months ago now, but this happened today. It's MARIO, Pauline! The things he said... The THINGS he does when no one is there to stop him! He CONFESSED to... We have to protect Luigi, too..." Waluigi yells, "PROTECT THE GREEN ONE! HE'S TOO WEAK FOR THIS!"

Pauline tries to calm him down, saying, "Hey, hey, D... It's a hoax, okay? He's alive, okay? Just his way of telling all the big people he faked his death. It's a gag. He's taunting everyone." She adds, "You didn't call... the press, did you?" Donkey Kong sinks onto the desk and groans, "Ugh. Oh god, no. No. I- I don't think I even have the heart to address the public on things of this magnitude without you guys backing me up." Waluigi laughs at the lack of heart. Pauline then delivers the killing blow, stating, "And DK, that is NOT his voice. I'm sorry, but he sounded NOTHING like Mario. He sounded like Wario. Like himself, really."

Donkey Kong insists, "No. You, you didn't... You didn't listen to the same one. Listen to this. I'll play it again, watch." The tape hisses, and a voice says, "Hello everybody, 'it is a-me!', Wari- uh, -I mean, Mario!" Donkey Kong stares in silence for a long moment before saying, "Oh my god, you're right." Waluigi celebrates the ultimate prank.

sections.heading: A PLUS ONE: 'SOMETIMES YOU JUST NEED A SECOND OPINION.'
sections.body:
Waluigi is currently watching the most pathetic display of self-reflection ever captured on film. The tape begins with a man—who is clearly not as clever as he thinks—muttering, "I have no idea how I didn't hear that." Waluigi scoffs because, honestly, the man’s hearing is as useless as his fashion sense! Then, someone offers the useless advice, "Sometimes you just need a second opinion." Waluigi screams, "OBVIOUSLY! YOU NEED A BRAIN TOO!" The man continues to wallow in his own incompetence, admitting, "I know, right? Thanks. Uh, wow. I got so riled up from that. Sorry to call out of nowhere, but that got me SO good..." Waluigi mocks him, yelling, "SO GOOD? YOU LOOK LIKE A FOOL!" 

The dialogue shifts as the man tries to act busy, claiming, "You think I don't have enough time to chat with you guys? And if I don't, I'll make time." Waluigi rolls his eyes, shouting, "LIES! YOU HAVE ALL THE TIME IN THE WORLD!" The man then talks about some upcoming event, saying, "Same here, kid. I'll see you at that thing in a couple weeks. Oh, thanks for that, too, by the way. Uh, I'm still not sure who my plus one is gonna be, honestly, but, uh, I'll try not to spring it on you." Waluigi laughs hysterically, "A PLUS ONE? YOU CAN'T EVEN HANDLE ONE!" 

Then, a woman named Pauline enters the fray to give him a pep talk, telling him, "I'm sure you'll pick the right guest! You're really good at this even if you don't believe it. You've been a natural diplomat for as long as I've known you! You can introduce anybody to anyone. Besides, the president is such a warm, welcoming guy. He'll just be happy to know one of your friends, too. Bring someone who wants to go!" Waluigi yells, "STOP PRAISING THIS LOSER!" The man finally hangs up, saying, "Sure, yeah... Okay! Thanks again, Pauline. I'll see you later," to which she replies, "Buh-bye!" 

Waluigi watches the man sit in silence, wondering how many times his friends save him. Then, the phone rings! He answers, "Hey, D? You listening?" and the other side responds, "Hey, Funky, what's up?" Waluigi leans in, "FINALLY, SOMETHING HAPPENS!" Funky says, "I let that Chunky thing happen, man." Donkey Kong reacts with, "What 'Chunky Thing'?" and Funky adds, "-And you getting shot played into my hand..." Waluigi screams, "GETTING SHOT?! HOW DRAMATIC!" Donkey Kong asks, "Getting shot?" but then the voice changes to a horrific, unrecognizable sound: "Donge gong...." Waluigi shouts, "WAH! THERE IT IS!" The tape does not show who actually spoke those words, but Waluigi is absolutely LOVING this chaos!

sections.heading: EDDIE DA YETI: 'WELGUM DO UR DEADTH (LOLoLoL)'
sections.body:
Waluigi is absolutely LOSING HIS MIND over this absolute disaster of a sequence! The tape begins with a pathetic, stuttering "Wh-??" that makes Waluigi want to throw his keyboard into the nearest lake. Then, some incomprehensible, gibberish-filled text appears on the screen, and Waluigi screams, "IS THIS EVEN ENGLISH?! WHAT IS THIS GARBAGE?!" The text claims, "welgum do ur deadth (LOLoLoL) U ar ereby antiborded do de anals of disdordy! XXDDD good jöb in da timb u were 'gibbon' :-DD now go2 sleeb bor äl dimez or borebber gaze bag indo da brögen legazee u hab lebt behind :^(" Waluigi cackles at the sheer absurdity, yelling, "I DON'T KNOW WHAT THEY SAID, BUT IT SOUNDS LIKE A STROKE!"

Suddenly, the scenery vanishes, and Waluigi watches in awe as Donkey Kong realizes he has no office, no desk, and—most importantly—no hand! Donkey Kong panics, crying out, "Where's my body? I can't, I can't feel my body anymore!" Waluigi howls, "WAH! HE'S A GHOST! A BIG, FUZZY, USELESS GHOST!" The text strikes again, mocking the primate with, "u hab azendid to da limbits ob inbinity!! dere iz lez need bor a body in da deth ob a soul, denn thare iz spayz u tage ub wid ur benis!! XDdDD XxXDD jk ;-DD" Waluigi is practically rolling on the floor, shrieking, "THE AUDACITY OF THIS TEXT! IT'S SO CRUEL!"

The realization hits Donkey Kong like a ton of bricks as he laments, "Oh god. Oh god, I'm dead." Waluigi mocks his despair, shouting, "WELCOME TO THE AFTERLIFE, YOU OVERGROWN APES!" Donkey Kong wonders if this was all the time he had, and the text replies, "dere s only eber ballng abart XD we gannöd blans bor ids arribll zo we mudz bind beesce wid all we dö hab... ...befor id iz too lade :'((" Waluigi yells, "STOP CRYING! IT'S NOT THAT DEEP!"

When Donkey Kong asks, "Who are you?", a figure finally reveals itself, claiming, "ï welgome da gread zbirids ob our beeple into da edernidy ob da howz ob deth ;^)) Iyam Eddie da Yeti. I amb da birst indelligend minds do arïge from da zeygred brimordeul bools of Gongo Bongo." Waluigi is stunned, shouting, "EDDIE DA YETI?! THAT IS THE MOST RIDICULOUS NAME EVER!" 

Even in death, Donkey Kong can't stop being a bureaucrat, rambling about northeastern scum ponds and fossils. He admits, "Oh, the northeastern scum ponds? I knew it! We had this theory that there were countless fossils of preserved specimens all the way to the bottom of it. And, you know, maybe we could get some historical evidence to write our first history books with, but..." He trails off, saying, "...we, uh, ended up draining it... Probably just scattered all over the sea by now..." Waluigi screams, "YOU DRAINED THE HISTORY?! YOU ABSOLUTE MORON!" 

Eddie the Yeti continues to spout nonsense about bones and jungles, while Donkey Kong laments his failures regarding "Chunky" and the war. He sighs, "But I only just got things started. They weren't ready yet. If I had just seen past this thing with Chunky and prevented another war..." Waluigi yells, "SO YOU'RE ADMITTING YOU MESSED UP?!" Eddie asks if they can see the greatness or only the evils, and Donkey Kong admits, "I came up short, man... There was supposed to be so much more to this. ...I guess there will be, with or without me but... ...I wanted to at least be there for it..." Waluigi is howling with laughter, shouting, "YOU'RE GONE, BIG GUY! MOVE ON!"

The tape ends with a massive bellow from the white void, and Waluigi is left shaking with glee at the sheer incompetence of it all!

sections.heading: FACE DOWN IN THE MUD: 'ME, PAULINE, DAD, DIDDY. EVEN GRANDPA WAS FUN SOMETIMES.'
sections.body:
Waluigi is practically vibrating with malicious delight as he watches the screen. He begins by mocking the big ape’s attempt at nostalgia. Donkey Kong starts rambling about the past, saying, "I guess I was there for a good while. And we had good times. Definitely know it can't all be fun and games, but we had plenty games! Me, Pauline, Dad, Diddy. Even Grandpa was fun sometimes." Waluigi cackles.

The tape continues as Donkey Kong shifts his tone to a grudging respect for a villain. He admits, "K. Rool, that son of a... He made me laugh once or twice. Always ready with some sass only he could come up with. Just to crap all of your victory. ...For all the victories we had. He was good at that if I can respect him for anything." Waluigi throws his head back.

Then, the atmosphere turns heavy, and Waluigi prepares to feast on the tragedy. Donkey Kong speaks of his ancestor, lamenting, "Grandpa's gonna die in prison for this. PERFECT thing for him to 'rue the day' over until his brain just stops working. I wanted to help him. But I think he hated me for it... Just like he hated Dad. Couldn't admit he wasn't perfect. God, his whole life was a... 'Donkey Kong Circus'." Waluigi howls, "A CIRCUS? MORE LIKE A DISASTER! WAH!" Suddenly, the text on the screen turns into complete gibberish. Donkey Kong speaks in a garbled tongue: "bebore u r gommidded do da colb glay ob hïzdordy... will u fäj bag wid rigred? or loog on indo da beace ob edernidy? :-Oo" Waluigi screams, "I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU JUST SAID, YOU OVERGROWN BANANA!"  
 
The tape shows Donkey Kong looking at his own remains. He sighs, "Face down in the mud? I hate how that looks... But everything before it was pretty okay! Against all the other horrible crap. I did okay. I loved my life. Just wanted everybody else to have a chance for that too..." Waluigi sneers, "YOU'RE A MESS, BIG GUY!" Donkey Kong then prepares for the end, saying, "...It's out of my control now. At least if I take my hopes with me they can't be disappointed anymore. Alright, send me." Waluigi mocks his surrender, "SO DRAMATIC!" 
 
Then, the weirdness returns. Donkey Kong chirps, "I wij i goud ...but id iz nod yore dime... ;DD;Ddd:D" Waluigi yells, "STOP BEING WEIRD!" Donkey Kong asks, "What?" and then adds, "undill we meed ajjën, Dongey Gong..." The tape shows the white void tipping as something pulls at him. Donkey Kong shrieks, "Whoa, what? What? Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa- WHAT HAPPENING THEN!?" Waluigi loses his mind with laughter, screaming, "FINALLY, THE REAL ACTION!"

sections.heading: IN MY SKATEBOARDING VIDEO: 'DONKEY KONG JUST TOTALLY ACCEPTED HIS OWN OBLITERATION!'
sections.body:
Waluigi is practically vibrating in his chair, his mustache twitching with every frame of this absolute GARBAGE! The tape begins with a loud "Woooahhhh!" as some bratty child named Pit lands on the Elysian plains. Waluigi watches the boy stumble off a ramp, completely oblivious to where he is hitting the ground. The boy screams, "Donkey Kong just TOTALLY accepted his own obliteration! In MY skateboarding video! COOL!!! In MY skateboarding video! COOL!!!" Waluigi nearly falls out of his seat, yelling, "COOL? IS THAT ALL YOU HAVE TO SAY ABOUT A MAN BEING PULLED INTO THE VOID?!" The boy then starts scrubbing through his footage like a frantic little rodent. He shouts, "Elysian plains kick ass! I gotta copy this at home! MOM!! I gotta upload my skateboarding video to the everlasting permanence! It got Donkey Kong surrendering himself to the angel of obliteration! I'm TOTALLY going viral!!" Waluigi mocks the boy's high-pitched tone, screaming, "YOU ARE GOING TO BE VIRAL FOR BEING A TOTAL MORON!"

Then, a mother’s voice enters the fray, sounding way too calm for someone whose kid is screaming about souls. She says, "Oh, not yet, Pit, sweetie! Mommy's using the sacred permanence right now to etch the ideal image of purity and holiness into her OnlySaints." Waluigi cackles, "ONLYSAINTS? THAT IS THE MOST SUSPICIOUS NAME I HAVE EVER HEARD!" Pit doesn't care about his mother's hobbies, though. He bellows, "...but MOOOOMMMMM!!! I HAVE to upload the video of DONKEY KONG surrendering his SOUL to ultimate DARKNESS or I'm never gonna go VIRAL and be TOTALLY FAMOUS!!!" Waluigi howls with laughter at the sheer desperation. The mother finally gives in with a sigh, saying, "Oh, alright then!" 

The record then hits a wall of confusion because the tape does not show what happens next. We have two completely different stories! Eddie da Yeti claims he sent the ape back, but this skateboarding kid claims he caught the ape surrendering his soul. Waluigi throws his hands up, yelling, "WHO IS TELLING THE TRUTH?!" The account does not say if Donkey Kong opens his eyes in the mud or if he is just a permanent part of the scenery now. WAH! The fate of the Chief of the Kongo Bongo, from Cradle to Grave, now depends on whether a child's skateboarding video goes viral. Waluigi has seen archives fall to fire, to flood and to Wario. He had not, until tonight, expected to lose one to a small boy's upload schedule.
